views.nsfwimg_note: -# Premium perk — fal.ai's NSFW model scores every image while the server's subscription is active.
views.nuke_desc: Protects your server against rogue moderators performing mass destructive actions.
views.raid_desc: Detects and responds to mass member join events.
views.raid_newacct: **New Account Filter:** accounts < `{days}` day(s) old get actioned first
views.raid_newacct_off: **New Account Filter:** disabled (all recent joiners actioned)
views.ext_mode1_desc: Detects raids driven by external tools by tracking how many recently-joined members fire bot interactions in quick succession, then identifies the operator via invite-use diff.
views.ext_mode2_desc: Detects slash commands fired by apps installed on a **user's account** rather than the server. Catches raid bots that never join the server and that most anti-raid tools miss.
views.ext_hint:
-# Raider/operator actions: `kick`, `ban`
-# Operator-only: `notify` (log + DM owner)
-# User-app action: `kick`, `ban`, `warn`, `log`
views.wl_desc: Whitelisted users and roles bypass all automod checks.
views.wl_hint: -# Use `.whitelist add user @user` or `.whitelist add role @role` to manage.
